strings.ui.crafts.experiment_help: Choose two to four herbs and put one of each in. A hidden recipe of exactly those herbs teaches itself; anything else comes out a Murky Pill. Herbs that fight each other blow the furnace.
strings.ui.crafts.experiment_log: Your experiment log: %d mixes tried, by every character.
strings.ui.crafts.experiment_no_herbs: You carry no herbs to experiment with.
strings.ui.crafts.fire_beast_fire_locked: Beast Fire burns a beast core: carry one.
strings.ui.crafts.fire_earth_fire_locked: Earth Fire burns only at a vent in the ground (one to a zone).
strings.ui.crafts.fire_heavenly_flame_locked: Absorb a Heavenly Flame first. Great beasts guard them.
strings.ui.crafts.furnace_stats: %d to a batch · heat +%d%% · filter %d%% · extra pill %d%%
strings.ui.crafts.no_furnace: No furnace in the furnace slot: one pill at a time.
strings.ui.crafts.soul_flees: The Pill Soul flees the furnace!
strings.ui.crafts.soul_lost: It slipped away: the pills settle as Pill Halo.
strings.ui.crafts.stage_soul: The Pill Soul flees: catch it at the mark
strings.ui.crafts.trace_hint: Trace the red path from the dot in one stroke: smooth and unhurried.
strings.ui.crafts.tribulation_begins: The sky darkens over the furnace: a pill tribulation!
strings.ui.credits.engine: Made with the Godot Engine (MIT licence).
strings.ui.credits.everything_else: World, props, creatures, icons, music and sound were generated for Jade River.
strings.ui.credits.fonts_body: Cormorant Garamond and Pixelify Sans, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Symbols from DejaVu Sans (Bitstream Vera licence).
strings.ui.cultivation.a_minor_step_fill_the: A minor step. Fill the bar and break through: no requirements, no risk.
strings.ui.cultivation.bath_none: Brew a bath first, then soak here.
strings.ui.cultivation.body_hint: Body XP comes from training stumps and lifting stones, kills, medicinal baths and body pills. Each rung needs its level, its Temper trial and a full soak in its bath.
strings.ui.cultivation.break_vow_confirm: Break the vow of %s? The heart demon grows by %d.
strings.ui.cultivation.choose_fate: A fate waits for you: choose it
strings.ui.cultivation.choose_what_to_cultivate_: Choose what to cultivate while you are away. Gains accrue at 10%% of active play for up to %d hours here (retreat rooms 16 h, gathering formations 24 h). Seclusion never breaks through for you.
strings.ui.cultivation.foundation_hollow: Hollow: too much of this realm's Qi came from pills. Your next great breakthrough counts it as an unmet requirement. Settle foundation in seclusion.
strings.ui.cultivation.foundation_sound: Share of this great realm's Qi that came from pills, raw herbs and cores. Above the red line the foundation is hollow.
strings.ui.cultivation.heart_calm: Your heart is quiet. Forced breakthroughs, a changed method, defeats and sin feed the demons.
strings.ui.cultivation.heart_demon_steps: Your next great breakthrough carries +%d risk from them, and they will stand beside your Reflection. Meditate, or burn Calm Incense.
strings.ui.cultivation.merit_not_ready: %d merit eases one great breakthrough in each realm.
strings.ui.cultivation.merit_ready: Your merit will ease a great breakthrough in this realm.
strings.ui.cultivation.no_dao_insight_yet_use: No Dao insight yet. Use techniques, meditate at insight stones and craft to begin comprehending.
strings.ui.cultivation.no_resistance: Your body has not learnt any pill yet.
strings.ui.cultivation.residue_harmless: %.1f  ·  not yet enough to slow you
strings.ui.cultivation.set_close_the_game_and: Set: %s. Close the game and your disciple cultivates.
strings.ui.cultivation.settle_foundation_desc: Makes pill-given Qi your own; burns off residue
strings.ui.cultivation.switch_method_you_lose_qp: Switch method? You lose %s QP and your foundation becomes Unstable for a while.
strings.ui.cultivation.vows_intro: A vow forbids one thing for as long as you hold it and gives a steady gift for it. Letting a vow go breaks it: +%d heart demon.
strings.ui.cultivation.you_know_no_cultivation_m: You know no cultivation method yet. Lu will teach you one.
strings.ui.exchange.100_taels_buy_1_spirit: 100 taels buy 1 Spirit Stone, less a 20% fee. Stones sell for 100 taels less the fee.
strings.ui.fates.intro: The breakthrough has shaken your fate loose. Keep one of the three: each gives something, and most take something back.
strings.ui.fates.none: No fate waits for you now. One is drawn after each great breakthrough.
strings.ui.fates.this_realm: Part of this lasts only until your next great realm.
strings.ui.fates.title: Breakthrough Fate
strings.ui.fishing.hold_to_reel_keep_the: Hold to reel · keep the line in the jade band
strings.ui.forge.cannot_salvage: Worn, bound and locked pieces are never salvaged.
strings.ui.forge.choose_both: Choose the piece to take from, then the piece to give to.
strings.ui.forge.enhance_help: Choose a piece on the left. Up to +5 an enhancement always takes. From there it can fail, but it never breaks the piece or takes a level: each failure adds 5% pity to the next try on that piece.
strings.ui.forge.failed: It did not take. Pity now +%d%%.
strings.ui.forge.inherit_help: Move a piece's enhancement, less two levels, onto a new piece for the same slot. The old piece goes back to +0.
strings.ui.forge.max: This piece is at +10, as far as the forge can take it.
strings.ui.forge.natal_broken: Broken: its power is dark until it is re-forged.
strings.ui.forge.natal_help: From Heart Tempering one weapon can be your Natal treasure. It grows with you: kills, techniques and ore fed at the forge raise it to level 10 (+2% stats a level), and its item level follows yours up to the grade band above its own. A boss's shatter blow, or drawing on it with too little Spirit, breaks it until it is re-forged.
strings.ui.forge.reroll_help: Choose a piece with affixes. Lock one affix to keep it (the reroll then costs double), roll the rest again, and choose the old roll or the new.
strings.ui.forge.salvage_help: Tap pieces to break them down into their metal and Refining Essence. Worn, bound and locked pieces are never salvaged.
strings.ui.garden.empty: Empty. Choose a seed below to plant.
strings.ui.garden.kind_note_steamed: Pills made from steamed herbs carry 30% less toxicity. A pill takes the prep of its principal herb.
strings.ui.garden.kind_note_wine: Pills made from wine-soaked herbs are 10% stronger. A pill takes the prep of its principal herb.
strings.ui.garden.need_water: Bottle water at a Qi spring.
strings.ui.garden.no_herbs: No plain herbs in your bag.
strings.ui.garden.no_rack: You need a drying rack. Mei Qing in Stoneford's Artisan Row gives one for Batch Work.
strings.ui.garden.no_seeds: No seeds in your bag. Granny Liu and the Greyreed trade post sell them.
strings.ui.garden.tap_a_bed: Tap a bed to tend it.
strings.ui.garden.title: Herb Garden
strings.ui.gift.given_today: They've had a gift from you today. Come back tomorrow.
strings.ui.gift.nothing: Nothing in your bag can be given away.
strings.ui.gift.pick_first: Pick something from your bag first.
strings.ui.gift.rules: One gift a day. What they love is worth a whole heart; what they like, a little less; anything else is a courtesy. Hearts open recipes, keepsakes, better prices and, for companions, bonds.
strings.ui.gift.title: A Gift
strings.ui.guild.commissions_locked: The board takes orders only from badge holders. Pass the Adept exam first.
strings.ui.guild.exam_task: Refine %s ×%d at %s quality or better within %d minutes.
strings.ui.guild.title: Alchemist Guild
strings.ui.herb.sense_spent: Picked. It grows back with its next ripening.
strings.ui.inventory.binding_hold_still: Binding… hold still, and do not be struck.
strings.ui.inventory.cape_slot_opens_at_heaven: Cape slot opens at Heaven Glimpse 1
strings.ui.inventory.fists_only_until_the_weapon: Fists only until the Weapon Hall (Bone Forging 3)
strings.ui.inventory.halo_charge: Halo +%d%% · grows in a dense-Qi storage chest
strings.ui.inventory.prep_steamed: Steamed: pills made from it carry 30% less toxicity.
strings.ui.inventory.prep_wine: Wine-soaked: pills made from it are 10% stronger.
strings.ui.inventory.sealed_bind_it_to_wake: Sealed: its power sleeps until you bind it.
strings.ui.inventory.soul_talisman_slot_opens_at: Soul Talisman slot opens at Spirit Awakening 1
strings.ui.inventory.spare_set: Set as your spare weapon. Swap with R or the Swap button.
strings.ui.inventory.tap_an_item_to_see: Tap an item to see what it does.
strings.ui.inventory.the_spirit_gourd_holds_your: The Spirit Gourd holds your bag
strings.ui.inventory.the_spirit_throws_you_off: The spirit throws you off. Your soul aches.
strings.ui.inventory.the_spirit_wakes_and_answer: The spirit wakes and answers you.
strings.ui.inventory.treasure_cost_soul: Costs %d Qi and %d Soul · %d s cooldown
strings.ui.inventory.unappraised: Sealed. It could be genuine, or a dyed fake. Appraise it before you trust it.
strings.ui.inventory.vessel_ridden: You ride it when you fly.
strings.ui.map.way_not_open: The way there is not open yet. The story will take you.
strings.ui.menu.save_and_return_to_character: Save and return to character selection?
strings.ui.mercy.line: They throw down their weapon and drop to one knee. “Enough! I yield! Do what you will.”
strings.ui.mercy.note: Some who are spared remember it. Some who are killed have kin.
strings.ui.mercy.title: Mercy
strings.ui.notice.all_of_today_missions_are: All of today's missions are done. New ones at dawn.
strings.ui.notice.missions_open_at_bone_forging: Missions open at Bone Forging 6 for sect disciples. They refresh at dawn.
strings.ui.pets.aptitude_hidden: growth and aptitude show at Juvenile
strings.ui.pets.egg_blood_why: Given, or your blood is still recovering
strings.ui.pets.egg_element_why: No core of another egg's element
strings.ui.pets.fuse_help: Fuse another animal into %s: a 30%% chance at each of its traits and learned skills, and half its purity above this one's. The other animal is gone for good.
strings.ui.pets.no_spirit_animals_yet_hermit: No spirit animals yet. Hermit Yao in the Reed Marsh looks after orphaned young ones.
strings.ui.pets.tap_to_use: Tap gear to wear it, a book to teach it
strings.ui.pets.wounded: Grievously wounded: -20% until it rests at the Beast Hall or takes a Beast Revival Pill.
strings.ui.quest.abandon_this_quest_you_can: Abandon this quest? You can take it again later.
strings.ui.quest.the_river_will_call_when: The river will call when it is time.
strings.ui.relations.alignment_note: Choices lean you one way or the other. Some masters and shops care which; your next realm never does.
strings.ui.relations.bond_dao_companion_note: One companion, for life, from one who holds you at five hearts. They support your breakthroughs and share what they learn.
strings.ui.relations.bond_master_note: The elder who took you as a personal disciple. Before you leave the valley, they pass on an art they never wrote down.
strings.ui.relations.bond_sworn_note: Up to three companions at four hearts, sworn under one name. Each one beside you makes the others stronger.
strings.ui.relations.challenge_later: At %d Fame (Rising), young masters of good families will come to towns looking for you.
strings.ui.relations.challenge_line: “So you are the one the valley keeps talking about. I have heard enough talk. Cross hands with me, here, where everyone can see.”
strings.ui.relations.challenge_stakes: Win: +%d Fame. Lose: −%d Fame. Decline: −%d Fame.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_legendary: They will be telling stories about you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_noted: Townsfolk know your name and greet you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_renowned: Your name travels ahead of you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_rising: Young masters come looking to test you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_unknown: No one has heard of you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_note: Tournaments, great foes and the Beast Tide raise your name. Losing a spar where a town can see costs you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_top: The highest a name can go
strings.ui.relations.fortune_note: Fortune encounters met: %d. At most one every three hours of play.
strings.ui.relations.grudges_note: Killing a faction's named people raises its grudge. Past its threshold it sends hunters after you. Blood money, a duel or a favour settles it.
strings.ui.relations.jealous_line: He saw the clouds gather over you and cannot bear it. "Heaven answered you? Show me why." A spar, at your new strength.
strings.ui.relations.merit_ready: Your merit will ease this great realm's next major breakthrough by one risk step.
strings.ui.relations.merit_short: %d more merit and the next major breakthrough is one risk step easier (every %d merit, once per great realm).
strings.ui.relations.merit_used: Merit has already eased a breakthrough in this great realm. It will again in the next.
strings.ui.relations.no_challenge: No one is waiting for you here. Young masters find you in towns, at most once a day.
strings.ui.relations.no_deeds: Nothing yet. Help someone, or cheat someone, and it will be written here.
strings.ui.relations.no_friends: No one yet. Help people, and bring them what they love.
strings.ui.relations.no_grudges: No faction wants you dead. Yet.
strings.ui.relations.sin_note: Sin feeds the heart demon and adds bolts to your heavenly tribulation.
strings.ui.relations.title: Relations
strings.ui.revival.soul_escape: Your nascent soul fled to the shrine: you lose 5% of this stage's progress and may carry an injury.
strings.ui.revival.you_lose_10_of_this: You lose 10% of this stage's progress and may carry an injury.
strings.ui.settings.could_not_export: Could not write the export file.
strings.ui.settings.keyboard_arrows_wasd_move_sp: Keyboard: arrows/WASD move · Space jump · J attack or talk · F interact · K guard (tap to dodge) · C cultivate (hold for the Cultivation page) · Q quick-use · Z and X treasures · 1–8 techniques · Tab menu · I bag · M map · L quests.
strings.ui.settings.no_exports_yet: No exports on this device yet.
strings.ui.settings.replace_your_saves_with_this: Replace every save on this device with this export? Your current saves are kept as a backup (.bak).
strings.ui.settings.saves_are_written_every_few: Saves are written every few seconds and when the app is paused. A backup of each file is kept and used automatically if a save is damaged.
strings.ui.shop.sell_for_a_quarter_of: Sell for a quarter of an item's value. Anything sold can be bought back today.
strings.ui.shop.tap_an_item_to_buy: Tap an item to buy. Shops refresh one rotating item each dawn.
strings.ui.techniques.more_slots_open_with_your: More slots open with your realm
strings.ui.techniques.no_inner_arts: No Inner Arts known yet. Your sect's Mission Hall teaches them from manuals, for contribution.
strings.ui.techniques.no_techniques_learned_at_q: No techniques learned. At Qi Kindling your training hall master will teach you your first.
strings.ui.techniques.tap_a_slot_to_wear: Tap a slot above to wear it.
strings.ui.training_sect.you_are_unaffiliated_th: You are Unaffiliated. The Jade Sect and the Cloud Sect recruit at the Stoneford Fairground.
strings.ui.welcome.extend_it_with_retreat_rooms: Extend it with retreat rooms and formations
strings.ui.welcome.set_seclusion_or_an_idle: Set seclusion or an idle task before you leave
strings.ui.workshop.found_your_own_sect_first: Found your own sect first. Its disciples are yours to teach.
strings.ui.workshop.guide_your_qi_through_the: Guide your Qi through the needles to clear a patient's blockage. Each treatment costs %d%% of your Qi and earns %d contribution. Patients waiting today: %d.
strings.ui.workshop.look_closely_real_jade_is: Look closely: real jade is cold and heavy, glass is warm.
strings.ui.workshop.none_stand_where_you_cultiva: None. Stand where you cultivate or fight, then place one. Fuel burns even while you are away.
strings.ui.workshop.nothing_to_appraise_curios_t: Nothing to appraise. Curios turn up in trade houses and old chests.
strings.ui.workshop.patients_wait_in_the_sect: Patients wait in the sect infirmary
strings.ui.workshop.reach_explanation_in_a_dao: Reach Explanation in a Dao before you can teach it.
strings.ui.workshop.the_puppet_stirs_and_sets: The puppet stirs and sets to work.
strings.ui.workshop.water_worms_and_time_eat: Water, worms and time eat manuals. Ink and insight give them back. What survives is never quite certain.
strings.ui.workshop.you_need_an_appraiser_loupe: You need an Appraiser's Loupe (Elder Gu's Trade House).
strings.ui.your_sect.damaged_in_a_raid_output: Damaged in a raid · output halved
strings.ui.your_sect.the_hidden_vale_beyond_cran: The Hidden Vale beyond Crane Falls could hold a sect of your own. Name it to found it.
strings.world_view.fame_greet_noted: Aren't you %s? I've heard the name.
strings.world_view.fame_greet_rising: %s! They say you're one to watch.
